newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas untraded, July talks near 9.35 p/t.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas untraded, July talks near 9.35 p/t.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Thursday morning.
Only a handful of months posted bids and offers at levels close to Wednesday's close.
July was bid at 9.250 pence per therm and offered at 9.500 after closing at 9.350 on Wednesday. March next year was asked at Wednesday settle's of 13.750 but was bid no better than 13.000.
"Most activity is still on the OTC market. We just haven't attracted much interest this morning," said a broker.
